Job Title: Lead Generation For Web Development Agency
Description: Research SaaS, funded startup, tech, and growth-stage companies matching ICP; collect verified contacts and company metadata.
Deliverable: Initial batch of 100 ICP-matching leads in spreadsheet
Qualification Criteria: Roles, company type, funding/revenue, region, size, optional tech stack/ad activity
Verification Required: Yes: verified contact data and ICP fit
Buying Signal Required: Optional: funding, old tech stack, paid ads/campaigns
Tool Requirement: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase or similar
AI Completion Notes: High: AI can help identify/filter companies, infer ICP fit, structure spreadsheet, find signals; email verification still needs tools.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium: lead gen tools and data accuracy expected; price is low.

Description: Strategic lead research for cybersecurity/IT firm; research competitors, forums/groups, SMB pain points, build hyper-targeted verified lead lists, identify opportunities/signals.
Deliverable: Repeatable lead engine inputs: verified prospects, ICP improvements, opportunity findings, meeting reports
Qualification Criteria: SMB industries, ICP targeting, pain points, opportunity signals
Verification Required: Yes: verified prospects and clean data
Prioritization Required: Yes: hyper-targeted fit and opportunity quality
Buying Signal Required: Yes: expansion, tech-related job posts, pain points from groups/forums
Personalization Required: Possibly: meetings and reporting require contextual insights
AI Completion Notes: High: AI can monitor public signals, extract pain points, score fit, draft account notes; human judgment needed in prioritization.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium-high: strategic thinking, meetings with COO, forum/group research; low hourly despite L3 scope.

Description: Extract ecommerce stores from Storeleads with filters; identify stores shipping Netherlands to USA; provide buyer/decision-maker details.
Deliverable: Filtered ecommerce prospect list with decision-maker names, emails, LinkedIn profiles
Qualification Criteria: Storeleads filters; shipping from Netherlands to USA
Buying Signal Required: No explicit buying signal beyond shipping criterion
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI can help filter and structure, but Storeleads access is core.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium: depends on paid database and competition is high.

Job Title: Contact List Building Specialist – Real Estate Agencies (USA)
Description: Build high-quality list of US real estate agencies; collect verified brokers, owners, or key decision-makers.
Deliverable: Google Sheet with agency, owner/broker, title, email, phone, website, LinkedIn; 90% accuracy required
Qualification Criteria: Real estate agencies in USA; brokers/owners/key decision-makers
Tool Requirement: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Hunter, Zillow, Realtor.com
AI Completion Notes: High for collection/enrichment; low judgment beyond role filtering.
Entry Barrier Notes: Low-medium: tools required; high competition; moderate hourly.

Job Title: Virtual Assistant for AI-Powered Lead Gen (ChatGPT, Clay, Apollo, Instantly)
Description: Support outbound lead-gen pipelines: build Apollo searches by ICP, import/process in Clay, dedupe, enrich, verify, generate icebreakers, QA Instantly campaigns.
Deliverable: ICP docs, clean deduplicated lead lists, Clay tables, verified emails, signals, 1-line icebreakers, campaign QA/reporting
Prioritization Required: Yes: ICP fit processing and signal strength
Tool Requirement: ChatGPT, Clay, Apollo, Instantly, BounceBan, AmpleLeads
AI Completion Notes: High AI leverage but much of task is sales ops/tool operation; L3 elements appear in signals/icebreakers.
Entry Barrier Notes: High: requires hands-on Clay/Apollo/Instantly and campaign QA.
Exclusion Reason: Tool-operation and campaign execution dominate; not standalone research SKU.

Job Title: B2B AI Lead Generation Expert Wanted – Automate & Scale Outreach with Results
Description: Design and implement AI-powered lead generation systems, enrich/qualify leads, set up outreach campaigns, optimize conversion.
Deliverable: Lead generation systems, workflows, outreach campaigns, performance tracking
Qualification Criteria: B2B client ICP, buyer personas, conversion metrics
Tool Requirement: Apollo, Clay, PhantomBuster, Lemlist, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
AI Completion Notes: Medium-high but systems/campaign execution is the purchased outcome.
Entry Barrier Notes: High: proven portfolio, automation stack, outreach performance.
Exclusion Reason: Automation/outreach system delivery, not lead research list product.

Job Title: Junior VA Needed for Recruiting Beta Reps for AI Chatbot Startup
Description: Find, contact, and secure beta reps; research agency owners/consultants, qualify/prioritize prospects, personalize outreach, track installs/case-study consent.
Deliverable: 50 potential beta reps by day 5; outreach log; 2+ rep agreements; 5 beta companies installed and consented
Qualification Criteria: ICP overlap, influence, responsiveness; agency owners/consultants
Price per Lead / Effective Rate: Hourly $10-$12, bonus up to $150 per successful company
Tool Requirement: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, GrowthMentor, Upwork, indie communities, PublicWWW/BuiltWith, Notion
AI Completion Notes: High for research, scoring, and personalization; execution/outreach still significant.
Exclusion Reason: Includes securing agreements and installations; outcome is recruiting/outreach, not just research.

Job Title: Outbound Sales Leader for Client Acquisition
Description: Build qualified prospect list, launch multichannel outreach, deliver discovery calls, report insights.
Deliverable: 100-200 organization list, outreach sequences, 10-15 qualified discovery calls, performance summary
Tool Requirement: CRM, Apollo or similar, outbound tools
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI can support account research and personalization, but sales execution dominates.
Entry Barrier Notes: High: outbound sales leadership and meeting generation required.
Exclusion Reason: Sales execution and meeting delivery dominate.

Job Title: B2B List Builder & LinkedIn Campaign Assistant
Description: Behind-the-scenes assistant for list building, LinkedIn campaign support, CRM/admin, sales-call note-taking.
Deliverable: Lists, LinkedIn campaign support, CRM updates, reports, follow-up tasks
Tool Requirement: Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outbound/LinkedIn automation tools, CRM
AI Completion Notes: High for list support but limited independent judgment.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium: time-zone constraint and campaign ops.
Exclusion Reason: VA/campaign assistant role, not standalone qualified lead research.

Job Title: Sales Development Representative Needed for Lead Generation
Description: Identify prospects, conduct outreach, qualify leads, set meetings with decision-makers.
Deliverable: Prospect research plus outreach/meeting-setting pipeline activity
AI Completion Notes: AI can support research, but core value is SDR communication.

Description: Convert warm pre-qualified small business leads into customers via telesales; prepare, call, and write closing report.
Deliverable: Pre-call prep, call recording/transcript, call notes, closing report
Qualification Criteria: Pre-qualified small business leads supplied by client
Personalization Required: No research personalization; call prep only
AI Completion Notes: Low: AI can help prep, but selling/closing is human execution.
